Todd is the first AI-powered agriculture company designed for sustainable farming, blending agronomy research with technology. We focus on balancing and remineralizing soil, improving surrounding environments and improving health through mineral rich vegetables and fruit. We explore any territory in pursuit of an idea, taking unconventional approaches and making big, bold decisions in unexpected ways. Our internships offer the chance to make a direct impact at Todd and contribute to Todd’s growth journey.


We will win for two reasons:



- There is no other company doing this (yet)
- You can tell the CEO he’s wrong


About the role:


Internships are available remotely in the US within a range of teams from marketing to technology, finance or talent to name a few. You’ll generally be with Todd for 12 weeks and be fully embedded within the team. Our teams are a mix of staff-level college students and tuff 19 yr olds.


Mentorship plays a big role for our interns too — you’ll be paired with one of our senior leaders, providing coaching and support one-to-one throughout the program.


You might be a good fit if you are:



- One of the best [fill in the blank] in the world
- Crazy cracked
- You like what you do
- Down to work for the coolest startup ever


This program does not provide monetary compensation (i.e. no pay) standard. Depending on skill, compensation is an option.


This position does not support work authorization/visa sponsorship.

role: Data Science/ Software Engineer Intern Fall 2026 Internship La Jolla, San Diego, CA
jd:
Allied Legacy Partners
Data Science/ Software Engineer Intern
Fall 2026 Internship • La Jolla, San Diego, CA • For Academic Credit




About the Role
We are excited to offer a Fall 2026 internship opportunity designed for college students in the La Jolla, San Diego area who are able to commute to our office. As a Data Science / Software Engineer Intern, you’ll be handling real operational problems and the latitude to figure out how technology can solve them – prototyping ideas, testing what works, and helping push forward projects that genuinely change how the company runs. We run a modern stack (CINC, a custom Supabase data platform, HubSpot, RingCentral, n8n, and Google Workspace) and we use software, AI, and automation to do more with a lean team.
We’re building toward bigger things: AI systems that handle multi-step work end-to-end, internal tools that replace software we currently pay for, a continuously running engine that sources and scores acquisition targets, and live dashboards that leadership actually makes decisions from. You’ll contribute to that vision, and the more you bring curiosity and original thinking, the more you’ll get to own. This internship is offered for academic credit in coordination with your university.
What You’ll Do
Build and test n8n automation workflows that connect our tools and eliminate repetitive manual work.
Prototype and test new ideas: take a process that’s slow or manual, propose a better way, and build a working version to see if it holds up.
Help develop AI-powered workflows using the Claude and Gemini APIs, from simple drafting and extraction toward more ambitious multi-step systems that read inputs, make decisions, and produce finished work for human review.
Run recurring data-extraction jobs, such as pulling figures from HOA financial-statement PDFs into structured spreadsheets.
Support data cleanup, entry, and validation in our Supabase platform and across spreadsheets.
Help design, build, and test internal tools and dashboards that staff use day to day: including early versions of tools that could replace software we currently buy.
Maintain data quality in HubSpot, and support the competitive-intelligence and acquisition research process by gathering, organizing, scoring, and verifying company and contact data.
Document how workflows and tools function, and take ownership of well-defined projects from start to finish.
What We’re Looking For
Outside-the-box thinking. You don’t just complete the task in front of you. Ask whether there’s a smarter way to do it, and you’re eager to test your ideas rather than wait for permission.
Self-direction. Excellent attention to detail and the ability to work independently in an unstructured, fast-paced environment with minimal hands-on oversight.
Comfort with technology. You’re not intimidated by new software, spreadsheets, or learning a tool on the fly. Exposure to any of SQL, Python, automation platforms, or AI tools is a plus, but resourcefulness and a willingness to learn matter more than a finished skill set.
Analytical aptitude. Strong analytical skills and an aptitude for breaking down data and business problems.
Communication. Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with diverse team members and explain what you built and why.
Genuine interest. Real curiosity for technology, automation, and AI, and how they can transform how a business operates.
Benefits
Gain hands-on experience with a real production stack – automation (n8n), databases (Supabase/Postgres), CRMs (HubSpot), and applied AI – skills that transfer to almost any modern company.
Work on genuinely ambitious problems, not busywork, with room to propose and test your own ideas.
Work closely with experienced professionals in a collaborative, mentorship-oriented environment.
Access valuable networking opportunities within the technology and business community.
Flexible work arrangements to accommodate academic commitments.
Real projects you can point to, plus exposure to many aspects of how a growing business runs on technology.
Potential for future career growth within the organization based on performance and alignment.
To Apply
Please submit via LinkedIn and send a resume and cover letter to david@alliedlegacypartners.com, directly to the founder. Use the following subject line:
ALP HOA Tech Intern Candidate: {Full Name}, {School}
In the cover letter, please briefly explain:
Your interest in this internship and how it fits with your current career goals.
Any relevant experience you have (coursework, work experience, projects, or things you’ve built on your own).
A time you came up with a creative or unconventional solution to a problem, or built something that didn’t exist yet.
Your ability or experience working in unstructured and ambiguous environments with minimal hands-on oversight (your ability to self-motivate and self-supervise).
Your available time commitment in person at our La Jolla, San Diego office: 20 hours per week during the school year, starting September 2026 and onward.




All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.
Please note that all applications will be reviewed by the founder and are not automated.
Location: La Jolla, San Diego, California
fit_why: Strong fit on Python/SQL, automation and AI APIs; startup-style data/tools role
